author: vivirancy
name: Topics
install_msg:
Thank you for installing Topics!
Run `[p]topicset modlog #your-staff-channel` so moderators can follow up on change requests, then `[p]topicset settings` to review everything.

For `changetopic` to be genuinely anonymous, the bot owner should enable slash commands: `[p]slash enablecog Topics` followed by `[p]slash sync`.
short: Suggest conversation topics, and let anyone anonymously ask to change the subject.
description: Hands out random conversation starters from a built-in list plus anything you add yourself. Members can anonymously ask the channel to move on to something else, with an optional note attached; the channel sees only that someone asked, while moderators get a private log naming the requester and linking to the conversation.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the Discord user ID and a timestamp for each member who requests a topic change, solely to enforce the per-member cooldown. That record is deleted on a data deletion request. Separately, when a moderator log channel is configured, each request is posted there naming the member who made it; those messages are part of the server's own message history and are retained according to that channel, outside this cog's control.
